mechanism_narrative: When the FEDFUNDS rate rises by more than 0.25% in a month, the S&P 500 20-day forward return is expected to turn negative due to tightened financing conditions.
failure_condition: Over 60-day window, no significant negative return (t-test p > 0.05) when FEDFUNDS crosses the threshold upward.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in PAYEMS (employment) of at least 50,000 jobs is associated with a positive S&P 500 5-day forward return, reflecting stronger labor market momentum.
failure_condition: In 20-day window post-trigger, returns are not statistically positive (p > 0.10).

mechanism_narrative: When HOUST (retail sales) exceeds 450 in a month, the S&P 500 60-day forward return is predicted to be positive, indicating resilient consumer demand.
failure_condition: Over 12 such months, average 60-day return is not higher than baseline (mean difference ≤ 0).

mechanism_narrative: A consecutive decline in INDPRO (industrial production) of 2% for two consecutive months predicts a negative S&P 500 20-day forward return due to supply-side weakness.
failure_condition: No significant negative return (p > 0.10) during any 20-day window meeting the trigger.

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE (unemployment rate) falls below 7% for three consecutive months, the S&P 500 20-day forward return is expected to be positive due to reduced labor cost pressures.
failure_condition: Over 50 such episodes, 20-day returns are not statistically positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in GDPC1 (GDP) and RSAFS (retail sales) of at least 2% and 5% respectively in a month indicate dual demand drivers, predicting a positive S&P 20-day forward return.
failure_condition: No significant positive return (p > 0.10) in any 20-day window with both proxies rising as specified.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in CPIAUCSL (inflation) below 2% for two consecutive months is associated with a positive S&P 60-day forward return as investors anticipate lower future rate hikes.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL < previous_month and CPIAUCSL < previous_to_previous_month and CPIAUCSL < 2
failure_condition: Over 12 such months, 60-day returns are not statistically positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the ratio of INDPRO to GDPC1 falls below 0.85 for three consecutive months, the S&P 20-day forward return is predicted to be negative due to supply-demand imbalance.
failure_condition: No significant negative return (p > 0.10) during any 20-day window where the ratio condition holds.
